how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 11-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IIT Delhi recruitment is 11th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies announced for various posts including Principal Project Scientist, Sr. Project Assistant, Sr. Research Engineer, Sr. Project Scientist, and Research Associate.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for these IIT Delhi posts?
faq.answer: The application process for these positions at IIT Delhi is through email. Candidates need to send their applications via email to the designated address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range for the Principal Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Principal Project Scientist post ranges from Rs. 75,600 to Rs. 1,01,610 per month, along with an HRA of 30%.

faq.question: Q6. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the Sr. Project Assistant (Tech) role?
faq.answer: For the Sr. Project Assistant (Tech) role, candidates need a B.Tech (1st class) or Graduate degree (1st class) with 05 years of experience in relevant fields.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions at IIT Delhi involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age relaxation provided for SC/ST or OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed advertisement for any such information.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for IIT Delhi recruitment-related information is http://ird.iitd.ac.in. You can find more details and updates there.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should be attached with the application email?
faq.answer: Candidates should attach self-attested copies of all required documents, including educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs, along with their application.
